Which letters do these marks go on?

Your language's character list includes these marks — ◌̀ ◌̂ ◌̌ — but doesn't show which letters they attach to. Without examples, the next step can't pre-select any letter+mark pairs, and you'd have to tick every pair by hand. Paste a long passage below (a chapter of scripture, a story, or a news article — the longer the better, since rare pairs only show up in longer text) and we'll learn the pairings from it.
